package e2e_test

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"testing"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/shopspring/decimal"

	"github.com/gopherex/ratel"

	"example.com/e2e/db/app"
	"example.com/e2e/db/queries"
	"example.com/e2e/doc"
)

func pool(t *testing.T) *pgxpool.Pool {
	t.Helper()

	config, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(os.Getenv("RATEL_E2E_DSN"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	config.AfterConnect = func(ctx context.Context, conn *pgx.Conn) error {
		if err := app.RegisterTypes(ctx, conn); err != nil {
			return err
		}

		return queries.RegisterTypes(ctx, conn)
	}

	result, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(t.Context(), config)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	t.Cleanup(result.Close)

	return result
}

func TestGenerated(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()
	db := ratel.New(pool(t))

	first := app.NewUserInsert("ann@example.com", app.UserStatusActive)
	first.Balance = ratel.OptFrom(decimal.RequireFromString("12.50"))
	first.Tags = ratel.OptFrom([]string{"a", "b"})
	first.Home = ratel.NullFrom(app.Address{Street: ratel.NullFrom("Main"), Zip: ratel.NullFrom("100")})
	first.Profile = ratel.NullFrom(doc.Profile{Name: "Ann"})

	users, err := db.Insert(app.Users, first, app.NewUserInsert("bob@example.com", app.UserStatusOnHold)).Returning(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(users) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("insert = %v, %v", users, err)
	}

	ann, err := db.From(app.Users).Where(app.Users.Email.Eq("ann@example.com")).One(ctx)
	if err != nil || !ann.Balance.Equal(decimal.RequireFromString("12.5")) || !slices.Equal(ann.Tags, []string{"a", "b"}) ||
		ann.Home.V.Street.V != "Main" || ann.Profile.V.Name != "Ann" || ann.Status != app.UserStatusActive {
		t.Fatalf("read = %+v, %v", ann, err)
	}

	_, err = db.Insert(app.Users, app.NewUserInsert("ann@example.com", app.UserStatusActive)).Exec(ctx)
	if !errors.Is(err, app.ErrUsersEmailKey) {
		t.Fatalf("duplicate email error = %v", err)
	}

	bob := users[1]

	for index, owner := range []int64{ann.ID, ann.ID, bob.ID} {
		row := app.NewOrderInsert(int64(index+1), owner, decimal.NewFromInt(int64(10*(index+1))))
		if _, err := db.Insert(app.Orders, row).Exec(ctx); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}

	loaded, err := db.From(app.Users).Where(app.Users.ID.Eq(ann.ID)).With(app.Users.Orders).One(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if orders, err := loaded.Orders(); err != nil || len(orders) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("relation = %v, %v", orders, err)
	}

	rich, err := db.From(app.Users).Where(app.Users.Orders.Has(app.Orders.Total.Gt(decimal.NewFromInt(25)))).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(rich) != 1 || rich[0].ID != bob.ID {
		t.Fatalf("Has = %+v, %v", rich, err)
	}

	byEmail, err := queries.UserByEmail(ctx, db, "bob@example.com")
	if err != nil || byEmail.ID != bob.ID || byEmail.Status != app.UserStatusOnHold {
		t.Fatalf("UserByEmail = %+v, %v", byEmail, err)
	}

	if _, err := queries.UserByEmail(ctx, db, "nobody@example.com"); !errors.Is(err, ratel.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("missing user error = %v", err)
	}

	joined, err := queries.OrdersWithUsers(ctx, db)
	if err != nil || len(joined) != 3 || joined[0].User == nil || joined[0].User.ID != ann.ID || joined[2].User != nil {
		t.Fatalf("OrdersWithUsers = %+v, %v", joined, err)
	}

	emails, err := db.From(queries.EmailsQ.Args()).Where(queries.EmailsQ.ID.Eq(bob.ID)).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || len(emails) != 1 || emails[0].Email != "bob@example.com" {
		t.Fatalf("Emails builder = %+v, %v", emails, err)
	}

	tag, err := queries.CreateTag(ctx, db, 1, "go")
	if err != nil || tag.Label != "go" {
		t.Fatalf("CreateTag = %+v, %v", tag, err)
	}

	copied, err := queries.CopyTags(ctx, db, slices.Values([]queries.CopyTagsParams{{ID: 2, Label: "sql"}, {ID: 3, Label: "pg"}}))
	if err != nil || copied != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("CopyTags = %d, %v", copied, err)
	}

	deleted, err := queries.DeleteTag(ctx, db, 2)
	if err != nil || deleted != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("DeleteTag = %d, %v", deleted, err)
	}

	ann.Balance = decimal.NewFromInt(99)
	if _, err := db.Save(app.Users, ann).Exec(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	saved, err := db.From(app.Users).Where(app.Users.ID.Eq(ann.ID)).One(ctx)
	if err != nil || !saved.Balance.Equal(decimal.NewFromInt(99)) {
		t.Fatalf("Save = %+v, %v", saved, err)
	}

	stale := db.Save(app.Users, ann).ExpectVersion(app.Users.Email, "someone@example.com")
	if _, err := stale.Exec(ctx); !errors.Is(err, ratel.ErrStaleVersion) {
		t.Fatalf("stale Save error = %v", err)
	}

	count, err := db.From(app.Users).Count(ctx)
	if err != nil || count != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("Count = %d, %v", count, err)
	}

	ids, err := db.From(app.Users).OrderBy(app.Users.ID.Asc()).After(ann.ID).Pluck(app.Users.ID).List(ctx)
	if err != nil || !slices.Equal(ids, []int64{bob.ID}) {
		t.Fatalf("keyset Pluck = %v, %v", ids, err)
	}

	if _, err := db.DeleteRow(app.Orders, app.Order{ID: 3}).Exec(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	if _, err := db.DeleteRow(app.Orders, app.Order{ID: 3}).Exec(ctx); !errors.Is(err, ratel.ErrNotFound) {
		t.Fatalf("second DeleteRow error = %v", err)
	}
}
